intent: Initialize the third real-industry benchmark as a joint DRAM + NAND historical model-memory campaign. Reuse the existing CAP-0006 sealed blind-recall, saturation, fresh-context, post-seal verification and Evidence-final authority boundaries. The benchmark may expose future semantic gaps, but initialization must not add product code, a new capability, a new truth owner, or semiconductor-specific core schema.
rationale: CAP-0006 already owns memory campaign isolation, fragmentary recall, campaign saturation/seal, post-seal verification depth and research-only coverage state. Broadening the benchmark from DRAM-only to DRAM + NAND changes the research subject boundary, not campaign semantics. The storage benchmark deliberately keeps product-line metrics distinct while testing shared-company and shared-cycle hypotheses. Therefore the truthful admission remains reuse, not extend/new.
